confidence_notes: Restaurant and drink anchors rest on partial web evidence: Pisa-specific Numbeo beer and eating-out figures, national Italian ranges for meals and coffee, and Rome/Venice/Milan bar data for cocktails and wine. Those sources are mixed quality and some are travel blogs. Euro figures were converted at an assumed EUR/USD of about 1.15, which I did not search for. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and the Pisa context (a tourist and day-trip city with July peak demand); no accommodation prices were searched or inspected. FX came from search-result summaries of the RBA overview page for 18 Nov 2026, not from a directly opened RBA table, so verify against RBA table F11 or F1.
comparable_city_reasoning: Priced as a mid-sized Tuscan university city close to the Italian national average. Restaurant and eating-out levels follow Numbeo's Pisa indicator (about 2% above the Italian average). Drink and cocktail anchors are informed by Rome and Venice bar ranges, adjusted down for Pisa. Accommodation is benchmarked loosely against comparable Tuscan cities outside Florence.
